title: [GMCP 203.041.02] Production path: Reliability, durability, recovery, backup, and offline operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-041-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Crash-consistent journals and atomic state transitions recover tasks, approvals, registry snapshots, desired state and lifecycle operations without replaying side effects. Defined RPO/RTO targets are met under kill -9, power-loss simulation, corrupt/torn state, full disk and clock skew; backups are encrypted, versioned and restore-tested; and all declared local capabilities remain usable without network access. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
